title: Nemesis
description: Defines a major, recurring antagonist with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression systems.

name.description: The display name of the nemesis.

era.description: The primary era this nemesis is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How unique or powerful this nemesis is in the galaxy.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the nemesis, their role, and significance in the story. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this nemesis, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this nemesis is viewed and feared by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the nemesis.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this nemesis in the galaxy.

archetype.description: The FFG-inspired archetype defining their primary method of opposition.

motivations.description: What do they want? Why are they opposed to the player characters?

character_sheet.description: The Nemesis uses the same master character schema as the players.

minions.description: A list of Adversary IDs that this Nemesis typically commands.

progression_plan.description: Defines how the Nemesis will grow in power and influence.

xp_thresholds.description: Milestones that trigger an upgrade for the Nemesis.

trigger.description: e.g., 'After the PCs complete the Shadow Syndicate quest'.

upgrades.description: List of new features, items, or minions the Nemesis gains.

plot_hooks.description: A list of potential actions or schemes the Nemesis can initiate.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Member Of', 'Enemy Of', 'Commands', 'Allied With'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this nemesis type from Star Wars canon.

famous_nemeses.description: Notable nemeses of this type from Star Wars lore.

homeworld.description: The primary homeworld or origin of this nemesis.

cultural_notes.description: Important cultural information about this nemesis.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements specific to this nemesis.

social_dynamics.description: How this nemesis interacts with others in the galaxy.

common_motivations.description: Common motivations and goals for this nemesis.

nemesis_development.description: Guidance for nemesis development and progression.

base_prompt.description: Base prompt for generating images of this nemesis.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different contexts and situations.

target_type.description: The type of image being generated (e.g., 'Portrait', 'Action_Shot', 'Command_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Additional text to add to the prompt for this context.

image.description: Path to the nemesis image file.

icon.description: Path to the nemesis icon file.

color.description: Primary color associated with this nemesis for UI theming.
